chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Al-Reza (peace be upon him), who said:
The chick-peas is good for the back pain, and he used to call for it before the meal and after it.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of chickpeas according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) highlights the therapeutic efficacy of chickpeas (*hummus*) specifically for alleviating back pain, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating dietary habits with physical health. His practice of requesting them before and after meals underscores the concept of food as both sustenance and medicine (*tibb al-nabawi*), emphasizing consistent, moderate consumption for maintaining bodily strength and treating specific ailments.
